sequential_review.scope: Read full chapter and all notes after the reviewed opening; re-read revised passages and their surrounding sections.
changes: Replaced two general opening paragraphs with Netflix changing-artwork and engagement-label design concerns.
Made LinkedIn weak-tie definitions and their different results explicit.
conceptual_checks: Budget adds conditional chance outside the current allocation favorite, including ties and changing favorite.
Does not count actual outsider wins, aggregate shares, firms, independent experiments or welfare.
Persistent small chance and slowly shrinking chance can accumulate; halving example sums to one half.
Fisher-information bound and stronger lifetime result retain different conditions.
Infinite budget does not identify without input contrast; informative outcomes and any information used to estimate chances count.
Strong versus ordinary reinforcement credited; exploration sampling uses field design/objective, with correction boundary retained.
Internal trials, costs and decision relevance remain substantive, rather than inferring harm from organization count.
sequential_review.source_scope: Unchanged claims retain prior relevant full-source checks; targeted primary rechecks covered the revised Netflix/LinkedIn details and Kasy-Sautmann field implementation.
